caption:
Admission enquiry aayi, aur parents ne kahin aur le liya? Wo 3-4 schools compare karte hain. Jo saaf aur jaldi batata hai, wahi jeetta hai. 🏫

Business of the Day: Private school
1️⃣ Enquiry pe turant WhatsApp: fee structure + transport + school visit slot
2️⃣ Visit ke baad: teacher ka welcome note → 1-min "ek din school mein" video → "seats left" + form link
❌ Galti: "office aa jaiye". Working parents ke paas time nahi.

Save karo 🔖 admission season se pehle.
Comment "AUDIT" 👇 aapke school ka free plan.
